case.summary: Cardholder C09988 disputed an online transaction of $59.67 (ID 3534820) executed on 2016-12-11. The transaction was conducted using device D000431, which was new to the account and presented an identity mismatch flag M1. Knowledge graph analysis revealed that device D000431 is linked to 10 prior closed fraud cases and operated concurrently across four other high-risk cards during the alert window. Analysis of the cardholder's baseline revealed no recurring billing pattern to contradict the cardholder's dispute. The incident is confirmed as card-not-present fraud from a new device, resulting in a card block, case creation, connected-card monitoring, and regulatory reporting.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details confirmed card-not-present fraud involving cardholder C09988 on card C09988-K1, initiated following an explicit dispute by the customer. On December 11, 2016, at 22:39:08 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3534820) in the amount of $59.67 was executed for product type C. The cardholder reported not authorizing or recognizing this $59.67 purchase, which occurred in the online channel without an identified regional billing location. The transaction was conducted through device D000431, bearing the user agent profile 'Windows | unknown | edge 16.0 | unknown', which appeared as New to card C09988-K1. In addition to being a new device, the transaction triggered match flag M1, denoting an account mismatch. A review of cardholder C09988's prior purchasing history confirmed no recurring billing relationship or legitimate pattern matching the disputed transaction. Knowledge graph analysis identified device D000431 as a shared fraudulent entity linked to 10 prior confirmed fraud cases, including CC-5057 and CC-3580. Furthermore, during the alert period, device D000431 demonstrated a shared origin lift of 6.46 across four other compromised cards: C04965-K2, C07196-K2, C08374-K1, and C09616-K1. Total confirmed fraudulent exposure on account C09988-K1 amounts to $59.67. The institution has blocked card C09988-K1 to mitigate further losses, opened an investigation, and placed connected cards under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: The investigation was concluded in accordance with policy section 6 because the fraud probability reached a decisive level of 0.939 supported by multiple independent lines of evidence—specifically the direct cardholder dispute, device D000431's confirmed history in 10 prior fraud cases, and cross-card shared origin connections to four other cards—meaning further inquiries would not change the outcome.
